I found the cause in [VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts:323). `updateLiveness()` uses playback state and the current chunk as well as info state, so a Started or Resumed broadcast can appear grey while playback is stopped, paused, or buffering. `setState()`, `skipTo()`, and first-chunk handling can also change liveness independently of `setInfoState()`.

The fix should put the requested mapping in `determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness.ts` and have `setInfoState()` alone apply it through `setLiveness()`. The existing `setLiveness()` guard already prevents duplicate change events. Invalid incoming info states are currently ignored, so whether those events should reset liveness remains an ambiguity; the utility itself should return `not-live` for unknown or undefined input.

The existing model suite passes (40/40), but [its Resumed-without-chunks test](/app/test/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback-test.ts:193) expects the old grey behavior. **No project source or tests were edited**: this pass was limited to fault localization. Findings are recorded in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

Liveness now follows the broadcast info state through [determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/utils/determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness.ts). [VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts) applies that mapping only in `setInfoState()`, so playback controls and chunk boundaries no longer change the indicator independently.

All 50 focused tests pass. Formatting and ESLint pass. The repository-wide TypeScript check still reports five unrelated `MatrixClient` API errors in files outside this patch.

VERDICT: ACCEPT

The patch correctly maps broadcast info states to liveness in [determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/utils/determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness.ts) and updates liveness through `setInfoState` in [VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts](/app/src/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts). I found no correctness or regression issue.

Test command: `./node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath test/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback-test.ts test/voice-broadcast/utils/determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness-test.ts` — **2 suites passed, 50 tests passed**. `git diff --check` also passed.
